_about: SERIES SHELF of one-off translators: The Broadway Travellers (George Routledge & Sons, London, and Harper, New York, 1926-1931), edited by Sir E. Denison Ross and Eileen Power: first English translations of travel narratives. Pero Tafur (Malcolm Letts), Clavijo's Embassy to Tamerlane and Don Juan of Persia (Guy Le Strange), Ibn Battuta (H. A. R. Gibb), Bontekoe (Bodde-Hodgkinson and Geyl), Cortés's Five Letters (J. Bayard Morris), the Mornay memoirs (Lucy Crump), du Jarric's Akbar and the Jesuits (C. H. Payne) and Maudslay's Bernal Díaz, 1926-1929. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 56); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
